Report a background job's state

Source: R/background-job.R
job_status.Rd

Reads the status submit_job keeps beside a job, <job>.run.yml. A job whose process was killed never records its end, so a recorded running is checked against the process itself. A render also keeps <job>.run.progress, read here; a render started without submit_job, after the last submitted run or with none, is reported from that file alone. A progress file older than the run the status file records is ignored.

Usage

job_status(path, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

path

Character(1). The job's .qmd file.

quiet

Logical(1). FALSE prints a one-line summary.

Value

Invisibly, a list: state is one of "none", "submitted", "running", "finished", "failed" or "vanished"; the other elements are what the status file recorded (pid, created, host, started, ended, exit_code, elapsed_s, r_version), and log, the log file's path. progress, the render's progress record when there is one, with eta_s, the estimated seconds left in the current stage, and stale, TRUE when it has not changed for three reporting intervals and at least 30 minutes.

Details

A long step writes a line to the render log at most every getOption("hvtiRtemplates.progress_every", 10) minutes.

Examples

job <- file.path(tempdir(), "example.qmd")
writeLines("---\ntitle: example\n---", job)
job_status(job)
#> example.qmd: none
